# 0x401 — `shutdown_state`

DLC 1 · 10 Hz · status: **hypothesis**

0x00 while the bus is alive. 0x80 after the ignition is switched off, for at least half a minute while every other ID has already stopped.

## Layout

Bytes are numbered from 0. Multi-byte values are big-endian unless a row says otherwise. Bit 7 is the most significant bit of a byte.

| Byte | Content |
|---|---|
| B0 | `after_run` |

## Signals

| Signal | Where | Type | Value | Unit | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `after_run` | B0 bit 7 | flag | raw |  | hypothesis (medium) |

### `after_run`

0 for the whole ride, engine running or not. 1 only once the rest of the bus has gone quiet: at least 31 s of this frame alone at the end of one capture (the capture ends first), and the whole of a 205 s key-off inside another. The sender stays awake for a while after key-off and says so. An earlier reading (0x80 = engine running) was the wrong way round.

**Example:** `0x401  00` → 0
